s_en: The ability to tap into the energy locked inside your car’s battery to power tools, lights, campground gear, and essential home appliances during an outage has quickly become one of the most desirable EV features.   The problem? Many electric vehicles already on the road – including millions of Teslas (Model S, Model 3, Model X, and Model Y)! – were never sold with native vehicle-to-load (V2L) capability. The new D2 power adapter from  WETOX  changes all that, using the car’s native charge port

title_en: Tesla adds 2.4 kW vehicle-to-load to Model Y Premium with $80 adapter
title_zh: Tesla在Y Premium型機車中增加了2.4千瓦的車輛對載荷,配有80美元介面卡

title_ja: Teslaは$80のアダプターが付いているモデルYの報酬に2.4 kW車に荷を積む
title_ko: Tesla는 2.4 kW 차량 부하를 Model Y Premium으로 $ 80 어댑터로 추가합니다.
s_en: Tesla has switched on vehicle-to-load for the Model Y Premium in the US and Puerto Rico, letting owners pull 2.4 kW out of the car’s battery at 120 volts and 20 amps.   You need an $80 accessory to do it, and not every Model Y Premium can. Tesla says the adapter can be added during configuration or bought from the Tesla Shop.
s_zh: 特斯拉已經為美國和波多黎各的Y Premium型機車換裝車輛,讓車主以120伏特和20安培的速度從汽車電池中拉出2.4千瓦。 你需要80元的輔佐 而不是每個模範Y Premium可以。 特斯拉表示,介面卡可以在配置過程中新增,也可以從特斯拉商店購買.
s_zcn: 特斯拉已经为美国和波多黎各的Y Premium型机车换装车辆,让车主以120伏特和20安培的速度从汽车电池中拉出2.4千瓦。 你需要80元的辅佐 而不是每个模范Y Premium可以。 特斯拉表示,适配器可以在配置过程中添加,也可以从特斯拉商店购买.
